items.title: 52115_Danny Barker oral history interview
items.q: Everybody went to see Mattie Hite. She sang a song, 'Stop It Joe.' ... And she was a dynamic woman, and highly respected.

ctx.x: Mattie Hite. Everybody went to see Mattie Hite. She sang a song, "Stop It Joe." It was a fast thing. [SNAPS FINGERS] "Stop it, Joe." [SINGS, SNAPS] "Stop it, Joe." It was a fast thing she did. And she went from table to table, see. And she'd pick up the money, you know. They'd put it on the edge of the table with the bottle, you know, the Coca-Cola bottle. But she wouldn't do that. She said, "Give me that money. I ain't puttin' an act for nobody." And she was a dynamic woman, and highly respected. They'd say,…
